name: Director Sportif
description: Pack meters for Zwift: what your spot costs (Position), whether you are spending more than holding your place needs (Holding), the pack cost beyond Zwift's draft, and gap and left/right to the wheel. One tile per meter, in the order you choose.
author: PaulCurtis5227
